IRIS Synthetic Planning Notices — EDGE CASES

TEST FIXTURE — COMPLETELY SYNTHETIC DATA. Large synthetic stress dataset: 32 cards exercising classification, identity, dates, coordinates, markup variation, ambiguous locations, and malformed metadata. The records, titles, dates, coordinates, identifiers and URLs below are invented; they are NOT from thueringen.de and must never be presented as verified public planning announcements. Expectation attributes are for tests only and MUST NOT be used as input to the parser.

Fictitious fixture URL: https://example.invalid/thueringen/bauleitplanung. This page is provided for local parsing only. Do not make live network requests to these links.

Source-to-staging contract: This HTML simulates raw source-provided fields only: record ID, item URL, title, summary, publication date, procedural stage, land use, municipality, location wording and optional coordinates. The Python pipeline must derive source_system, source_key, approval_status, industrial_status, screening_status, geom, distance_to_a4_m, corridor_status and quality_flags. Ingestion timestamps (first_seen_at, last_seen_at, content_updated_at) belong to the database ingestion process, not the source HTML. Missing values should remain unknown, not invented.

The data-test-* attributes are test-only hints: never classify records using them. Labels such as candidate are provisional; a confirmed accepted row still requires a real valid A4 reference and verified proximity. Different HTML pages or mocked responses must represent successive scans when testing last_seen_at and content updates; repeated cards within one page test same-batch deduplication only.
